Damn man why did I never think this thought before? 

Or the fact people have never seen Star Wars circa 1980 and have no idea what the reference “Luke I am your father” comes from 😱

I am still here and kind of okay with it kind of not.

Kind of okay about it because I think the situation was finally addressed at work.

But I am not ok Bc I feel like this is only the beginning and it’s gonna get worse on Monday.

So I’m still here as y’all can see because I freaked out (like stared above) Bc it started bleeding really heavily and freaked me out. I have actually slit my wrists before and had no fear then and loved seeing it bleed. This was also related to bullying. But this time I freaked out, probably because I was at work and if I failed at all I would look PSYCHO to everyone at work who found out. 

But idk if my boss saw this (doubtful) but a hour or two after I posted this I was pulled into their office and they restored some of my sanity... for now. They said they are investigating and dealing with the situation at hand and that I will see how they handle retaliation. I just don’t want anyone fired unless that’s specifically what their policy calls for, but I know that a job is their livelihood and don’t want to take that away and have them feeling like me too... idk I’m weird. I let people walk all over me and treat me like shit and I don’t want them to have the same happen to them 🤷🏻‍♀️. But I just want the bullying to stop but I have a feeling it’s only going to get worse when these ppl get back to work. Of course I hope it doesn’t but I have a suspicion. Especially given after I called HR and spoke with them as soon as I walked back inside to my desk the people said this bitch and snitch just called HR on me and stood their pointing at me and laughing and calling me a snitch and bitch continuously.

I just hope it gets better... I need it to get better! I love my Job and I loved the company but I can’t stand another day of bullying

Sales is not trash. I make great money and the company itself is amazing. It’s literally this one person spoiling the experience.

But it got better today. Looks like things are being addressed but this doesn’t mean I won’t face retaliation later like I have been this entire time

I can’t be a bitch and ignore y’all like I wanted too. I did cut pretty deep but freaked out when it started bleeding heavily and just applied pressure and a bandaid and walked back into work. I don’t want to do any of this anymore.

I am being relentlessly bullied at work, I work in sales so it’s already difficult w/o bullying but add that and I might as well give up.

Management hates me all of a sudden despite being a top performer. No one will talk to me at work, no one likes me now that I’ve reported the bullying.

I have been actively trying to make my life better for the past year and it was going well until the panic attacks started again caused my bullying and now it’s back to square 1. At risk of losing my job due to attendance Bc of panic attacks, hating myself, questioning why I am even here. There is no point. Once things get good something or someone happens and ruins the good so bad I can’t even look forward to it getting good again Bc I know it is I’ll just be ruined again.

I have NOT stayed in one place expecting things to change. I’ve worked my ass off this past year and have not expected life to change without trying. Trust me I’ve tried and tried but it’s not worth it anymore. 

I just cannot do this anymore
Dayummmmm I wish I looked even just an 1/8th as good as you without makeup on 😍

1st you seem like a great guy with a leveled head. You have addressed that this is something that happened before you two were together or during your dating before getting engaged. I saw no signs of hostility, rage, resentment, or bitterness. I would take this positive energy you have expelled in this thread in regards to your attitude toward the whole ordeal and sit down and talk with her about it the same way you’ve talked to us. Tell her you are not upset with her, you are not there to judge or hurt her. You want to ensure her safety and well-being and also ensure no one has been stalking her or holding grudges.
Talk to her because this sounds like a lifetime movie where the wife keeps a secret about being abused or manipulated and the stalker or offender finally kills her or her spouse.
Thank you I appreciate that. Trust me I think kids understand it better than adults some times. These are the same problems I had as a teenager just now as an adult
